method: Playwright full-page screenshots compared pixel-by-pixel with pixelmatch (threshold 0.1, antialiasing excluded)
notes: Scores are evidence for the captured home-page states, not a claim of site-wide 100% parity.
The original contains time-varying alerts, session-dependent cookie states, protected data, and live backend responses.
Operational forms in the reconstruction are frontend-only and do not transmit data.
